mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, c1.C_Name as chSupervisorName, c2.C_Name as chUserUnitName, c3.C_Name as chContractorName, c1.C_Abbreviation as chSupervisorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as chUserUnitAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as chContractorAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Completion_Handover mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Completion_Acceptance ca on ca.Ca_Id=mn.Ca_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Ch_Supervisor_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Ch_User_Unit_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=mn.Ch_Contractor_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Ch_Id where mn.Ch_Id=#{chId}
